release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.9.4 Release — Perfected Zero-Popup YouTube Shorts & Channel Blocker:
• Eliminated WindowManager Overlays: Completely removed TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY for YouTube Shorts and channels. Zero Xiaomi/HyperOS 'Display pop-up windows in background' or 'High-risk operation' security warnings.
• Synchronous Tab Click Fix: Fixed asynchronous node recycling race condition. When the Shorts bottom tab is tapped, FocusDefend synchronously clicks the Home tab (pivot_bar index 0) before recycling the node tree.
• Instant Reel Ejection: Full-screen Shorts reels opened from feed or search are ejected within 0ms via GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK without closing YouTube.
• Smart Channel Header & Subscribe Button Extraction: Distracting channels are now caught via Subscribe button and Avatar content descriptions.
• Auto 0-Minute Enforcement: Activating YouTube Study Mode automatically enforces 0 minutes for Shorts.
